camel_example: aliyun esa ListPostpaidRatePlanInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --UnrelatedType bot --PageSize 12 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'sp-dps-xxxxxx' --SortBy CreateTime --SortOrder desc --CheckRemainingSiteQuota true
description_en: Queries the list of pay-as-you-go plan instances
description_zh: 查询后付费套餐实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-postpaid-rate-plan-instances --check-remaining-site-quota true --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 12 --status online --instance-id sp-dps-xxxxxx --unrelated-type bot --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPostpaidRatePlanInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check for remaining site quota. Valid values:

- true: Queries instances that have remaining site quota.

- false: Does not filter by this condition
parameters.help_zh:
检查是否有剩余站点配额。取值范围:

- true: 查询有剩余站点配额的实例

- false: 不进行此条件筛选
parameters.name: check_remaining_site_quota

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- CreateTime: sorted by creation time
parameters.help_zh:
按哪个字段排序。取值:

- CreateTime: 按创建时间排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

 * asc: ascending order

 * desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值:

 * asc: 升序

 * desc: 降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

 * online: Normal.

 * overdue: Overdue payment.

 * disable: Released
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值:

 * online: 正常使用状态

 * overdue: 已欠费

 * disable: 已释放
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Specify this parameter to query a specific instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，用于精确查找单个实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instance has purchased additional bot or DDoS protection
parameters.name: unrelated_type
